# Customization Control

Find duplicate customizations and repair local agent configuration.

| Maintenance | Dormant |
|---|---|
| Version | 0.1.10 |
| Clients | Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code (legacy) |
| License | MIT |
| Source | [Repository](https://github.com/0langa/customization-control) |

**Dormant:** Available as-is, with no planned updates. Existing releases remain installable.

## Example request

> Audit my local agent customizations and list duplicates without changing anything.

## Requirements

Windows PowerShell helpers and a Python helper for other platforms. Discovery rules may not reflect newer client layouts.

- PowerShell on Windows, or Python on macOS/Linux
- Local access to the relevant client configuration

## Install

### Codex

```shell
codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/0langa/plugins.git
codex plugin add customization-control@0langas-plugins
```

### Claude Code

```shell
claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/0langa/plugins.git
claude plugin install customization-control@0langas-plugins
```

## Setup and use

- Start with a read-only customization audit. Review the proposed changes before applying repairs or deduplication.
- Prefer each client's native plugin manager for routine installs and removal. This dormant plugin retains its older cross-provider audit and repair workflows.

## Legacy Kimi compatibility

Kimi compatibility is retained but is not actively tested. First prepare a [recursive checkout](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#development-checkout). Replace the example path with your checkout.

```text
/plugins marketplace C:\path\to\plugins\kimi-marketplace.json
/plugins install C:\path\to\plugins\plugins\customization-control
/reload
```
